baseline_warning: Constant-rate benchmark uses full evaluation outcomes (in-sample, look-ahead); diagnostic only, not a valid deployable baseline
method: chronological five-opportunity-confirmed-game mean threshold and smoothed empirical frequency; position-filtered, retains zero outcomes when attempts/targets/carries > 0; NOT sportsbook-line calibration
leakage_policy: Each prediction uses only earlier games for the same player and market
limitations: Opportunity-confirmed samples condition on observed attempts, targets or carries and exclude games with zero opportunity; this introduces post-game selection bias and is NOT a pregame hit probability. Snaps, routes, injury status and missing weekly rows are unverified. Synthetic thresholds, not posted odds or real SGP prices; no opponent, joint-correlation, or market EV validation
